assertions.name: genuine_smatrix_validated_and_bwS0_identification_refuted
assertions.source: Every transcribed formula from Hikami math-ph/0405028 machine-validates (Theorem 10 exact to ~1e-30; S^2=1; vacuum row = Cor 12 weights; round-2 derived characters = Hikami's chi^(111)/chi^(112)). The genuine Sigma(2,3,5) vacuum row is D=2-dimensional with golden-ratio ratio, refuting (scope (a)) the identification of the 4-class bwS0=d_q/D family with the vacuum row of this geometric object.

description: s013 step 3: the GENUINE Sigma(2,3,5) S-matrix from the primary literature (Hikami math-ph/0405028, owner-uploaded commit ece271823). Transcribes chi^(l1,l2,l3) (3.1), tau_N (2.11), phi=181/30 (2.12), Eichler limit (4.2), S-matrix (3.8, normalization sqrt(32/P)), Corollary 12 (5.8) -- and machine-validates ALL of it: Theorem 10 is an EXACT finite-N identity verified to ~1e-30 at N=3,5,7,11; S^2=1; the vacuum row equals Cor 12's flat-connection weights (2/sqrt5)(sin pi/5, sin 2pi/5) with CS=-1/120,-49/120; Cor 12 asymptotic residuals decrease in N. Cross-validation: Hikami chi^(111)/chi^(112) EQUAL the round-2 sympy-derived alpha=1/alpha=2 characters (eq. 5.6 is that identity), and the colored family spans exactly D=2 components (alpha=4=alpha=1, alpha=3=alpha=2). VERDICT: the genuine vacuum row is 2-dimensional with golden-ratio phi ratio (icosahedral/Fibonacci; magnitudes = sqrt(Reidemeister torsion), Thm 14); the keystone target bwS0=d_q/D at n=5 has 4 classes with ratios (1,4.110,5.220,6.220): type mismatch (2!=4) + value mismatch (phi not in targets) REFUTE the identification 'bwS0 = vacuum row of the Sigma(2,3,5) false-theta S-matrix' -- scope (a), this specific geometric object. The 3190 4<->4 correspondence is support-level only. No fit; nothing wired.
